system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The LLM utilizes Claude Sonnet 4 and ChatGPT-4o with engineered prompts designed to synthesize mathematical expressions while maintaining formal correctness.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; prompts (App. A) not in evidence. Prompts incorporate system description, retrieved examples and feedback, so templated inferred.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: First, it performs feature-based retrieval using automatically extracted system attributes such as dimension, time domain, linearity, and topology.
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value: feature-based filtering plus LLM ranking of prior solved systems, not lexical BM25. Mismatch; add to Ambiguities.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no history management described.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the Verifier Agent provides the violated conditions and counterexamples as feedback to the Synthesis Agent

tool_call_format.note: Paper only; output parsing mechanism not described.

tool_count.note: No model-facing tools described; fixed pipeline invokes solvers.

edit_primitive.note: Not a file-editing system; no tool registry in evidence.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The pipeline consists of four stages: (1) historical retrieval, (2) LLM-based synthesis, (3) two-stage verification, and (4) iterative refinement guided by feedback.
loop_primitives.note: K=5 main iterations each exploring new templates (multi_attempt), R=4 refinements from verifier feedback (generate_test_repair); Algorithm 1.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: In early refinements (r≤2 ), the agent adjusts coefficients while preserving structure; in later refinements (r >2 ), it performs structural modifications
planning_granularity.note: Fixed recipe; no plan object described.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The framework comprises three core agents operating in an iterative pipeline

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Feedback from the Verifier Agent is returned to the Synthesis Agent, forming a closed-loop interaction bounded by a global timeout.
delegation_mechanism.note: Fixed hand-off between role agents; mechanism not detailed.

short_term_state.note: Best score/partial solution and logged intermediate results tracked.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: A persistent database stores previously verified barrier certificates, which the Retrieval Agent accesses to accelerate synthesis on similar problems.
long_term_memory.note: Verified solutions stored via RETRIEVALAGENT.STORE; could also be read as skill_library.

self_verification.evidence_quote: it performs formal verification using SMT solvers such as Z3 (de Moura and Bjørner, 2008), Yices (Dutertre, 2014), and cvc5 (Barbosa et al., 2022), checking the unsatisfiability of negated barrier conditions.
self_verification.note: Preceded by 5000-point sample-based check (closest to test_execution-like check, not coded).

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The process terminates upon discovery of a valid barrier certificate or exhaustion of all attempts.
retry_policy.note: Capped at K=5 x R=4; could be fixed_n.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The process terminates upon discovery of a valid barrier certificate or exhaustion of all attempts.
termination_condition.note: Global timeout also bounds the loop (see F3).

timeouts.evidence_quote: forming a closed-loop interaction bounded by a global timeout
timeouts.note: Per-tool: verifier uses adaptive solver timeout adjustments (Sec. 3).

tracing.evidence_quote: The Verifier Agent logs all intermediate results, enabling cumulative feedback

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: By releasing BARRIERBENCHwith the accompanying toolchain, we aim to establish acommunity testbed
eval_hooks.note: Benchmark released with toolchain; repo not inspected.

target_domain.evidence_quote: we present anLLM-agentic framework for barrier certificate synthesisthat uses natural language reasoning to propose, refine, and validate candidate certificates.
target_domain.note: Formal safety verification of dynamical systems.

open_source.note: Benchmark public at hycodev.com; no licence or repo in evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: The LLM utilizes Claude Sonnet 4 and ChatGPT-4o

first_release_date.note: v1 date not in evidence (only v2 16 Apr 2026).
